title: Traverse stage 1: evening approach to Passo del Vivione (camp)
terrain: hike with pack, ~800m D+, no meaningful descent
coachNotes: OUTCOME: aborted mid-approach due to heavy thunderstorm; hiked back down and slept at home. Felt weak in the evening (post-fever), slept well. Load reduced to reflect the short out-and-back. Right call.
